# MinePolls
You can copy-paste this directly into **SpigotMC / Modrinth / CurseForge**.

---

## ✅ Plugin Description (Copy & Paste)

**MinePolls** is a lightweight and easy-to-use Minecraft plugin that allows server owners to create interactive polls directly in-game.

Players can vote by simply clicking on options in chat, making it fast, fun, and user-friendly. Perfect for deciding events, game modes, maps, or any community decision on your server!

### ⭐ Features

✔ Create polls with multi-word questions using quotes
✔ Clickable voting system (no typing required)
✔ Case-insensitive voting (Red = red = RED)
✔ Add or remove options while a poll is running
✔ Live result viewing
✔ Permission-based admin controls
✔ Lightweight and optimized
✔ Works on modern Paper / Spigot servers

### 🧾 Commands

```
/poll start "<question>" <option1> <option2> [option3...]
/poll vote <option>
/poll result
/poll addoption <option>
/poll removeoption <option>
/poll end
/poll help
```

### 🔐 Permissions

```
minepolls.poll  → Start, edit and end polls
```

### 🛠 Installation

1. Download the plugin jar
2. Put it inside your server's `/plugins` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Enjoy creating polls!

### 💡 Example

```
/poll start "Which map should we play?" Desert Forest City
```
